description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of narrative media framing types observed in political discourse in 2017. The chart contains three slices, each representing a different framing type: “Conflict” in blue, “Progress” in orange, and “Morality” in green. The “Conflict” slice is labeled with 46.0% (and the number 46), the “Progress” slice is labeled with 33.0% (and the number 33), and the “Morality” slice is labeled with 21.0% (and the number 21). The chart includes percentage labels displayed within each slice, and a legend identifying each framing type. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, starting with the largest (“Conflict”) and decreasing in size.
